title: Correlated Error Mosaic: multi-request correlation & root-cause lane
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a unified investigative surface — the Correlated Error Mosaic — that helps SREs and engineers find root causes across related failed requests. The Mosaic should combine temporal timelines, similarity clustering (payload + error class), retry chains, and a lightweight root-cause lane that surfaces likely causes with confidence scores. Goal: reduce mean time to triage (MTTT) for cross-request incidents and provide one-click context to open rollouts, logs, and model diffs.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive Mosaic view with time-window selector and density zoom
Clustered grouping of related requests by error taxonomy and payload similarity
Retry-chain expansion with aggregated retry outcomes and average latency deltas
Payload diff mode showing token-level colorized diffs for top-10 correlated requests
Root-cause lane with 3 ranked hypothesis cards and links to relevant rollouts/PRs
Keyboard accessible quick-jump to Console's Rollouts and Request Replay workflows
Prototype validated in design review with Engineering and PM sign-off
design_notes: Ship as an advanced view behind a Console beta toggle; keep default failure list unchanged
Use a hybrid visualization: left timeline + middle mosaic scatter clusters + right hypothesis lane
Color palette: use error-class hues (4 levels) + neutral for retries; ensure WCAG contrast
Performance: avoid rendering >2000 points client-side; include server-side aggregation for large windows
Persist user filters and time-range in query params for sharable investigation links
decisions: Move forward with cluster-by-(error_class, payload-signature, model-version) rather than full-text similarity to reduce compute at query time
Prototype using sampled data from the existing diagnostics index (engineering to provide sample API)
Defer on-demand full payload replay to a follow-up ticket; initial MVP includes payload diffs for top correlated set
tasks: Figma prototype of interactions (hover, expand, diff toggle)
Design token handoff and accessibility spec
Sync with ENG on diagnostic API schema and sampling contract
Run a 1-week usability test with two platform customers and internal SREs
